exceptions.reason: Vase UI does not have the shared suite. The case "grows from zero size to an on-screen 1px box when reported invalid" in the block "hidden input size" of the same test file tests the same behavior.

exceptions.title: prefers a render element's `aria-label` over an associated label
exceptions.reason: The case gives the `aria-label` as a prop of a React element in `render`. Base UI reads that prop with `React.isValidElement`. In Vue, an element with props of its own is the `#render` slot, and a part does not see an attribute that the slot adds. Base UI also does not see an attribute that a render function adds.

exceptions.title: preserves Field validation props through canceled changes, submit, and reset
exceptions.reason: The last lines of the case say that a native reset does not change the switch. Vase UI resets an uncontrolled switch to `defaultChecked` (`BUG-6206`). The case "preserves Field validation props through canceled changes, submit, and a native reset" has the other assertions of the upstream case and the reset of Vase UI. The block "BUG-6206: a native reset" tests the reset of a switch in a form.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `aria-label` to find out if a label names the switch, and `$attrs` is not reactive, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the element, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `aria-labelledby` to find out if a label names the switch, and `$attrs` is not reactive, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the element, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
